## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Broad sector gains (see XLV, XLP, XLF ABOVE TREND) conflict with major cap weakness — SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.56%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -8.61%) plus VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +3.86%) — mixed signals justify NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit modestly weaker: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.50%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -2.83%) showing slight tightening. Elevated volatility: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +3.86%) ↑ rising; equities vs bonds mixed with SPY BELOW TREND and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.91%) ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: dollar and curve signals are flat in the barometer while TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.91%) indicates higher rates pressure; overall financial conditions neither clearly easing nor tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Broad leadership across defensives and cyclicals: Healthcare XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +4.21%), Consumer Staples XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +5.01%), Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%); Energy XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +9.46%). Style: Value/Cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US large caps lag: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.56%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -8.61%). China strength: FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.91%); EM mixed with EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.03% | 1M: -9.43%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -12.46%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -3.48%). Spot bitcoin IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -3.59% | 1M: +5.32%) — selective risk-taking remains.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength over 1M with short-term pullbacks: BNO CORRECTION (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +23.45%) and CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +3.01%). Gold in CORRECTION (GLD 1W: -2.12% | 1M: +0.68%) — profit taking but not a clear directional shift.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +9.46%) while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -13.12%) ↓ falling — oil up over month, nat-gas weak short term.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: sector breadth (8/11) and Financials XLF ABOVE TREND supporting cyclical exposure; Divergence: major cap indices (SPY, QQQ) and tech XLK BELOW TREND alongside VXX ABOVE TREND — watch volatility and leadership drift. No MAJOR divergence across core ETFs that forces regime change, but mixed signals warrant selectivity.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to areas showing strength — XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +4.21%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.11%); reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%) and semis SOXX BELOW TREND (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.31%). Monitor VXX ABOVE TREND and IBIT CORRECTION for risk signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Healthcare XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +4.21%), Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +6.07%), Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.11%). BEARISH: Technology XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.60% | 1M: -10.16%), Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -2.68%), Semis SOXX BELOW TREND (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.31%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent BNO CORRECTION (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +23.45%) and broader energy XLE CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +9.46%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -13.12%) and uranium URA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -14.59%).

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX around 20 as a volatility pivot given VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +3.86%); HYG/LQD spread and levels near historical 0.80 for credit health; XLK/ XLF leadership cross as a style pivot (XLK BELOW TREND vs XLF ABOVE TREND); SPY support areas implied by BELOW TREND action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive while major indices and tech remain BELOW TREND, creating a split market. Healthcare, Staples and Financials showing strength; key risk is divergence between broad sector participation and cap-weighted weakness with elevated VXX.
